note: The two sets are nearly identical in substance and share the same errors: both read the 1/4" slope symbols as a thickness (support plates, floor overhang) even though the plate is named 11"X3/8", and both treat the section-cut label B-L1a-GF as a detail reference and bind grid line "E" as a location. A is marginally more faithful in that it keeps the Detail C1 condition on the L4X4X5/16 and 1/4" claims and names the angle as the fastener owner, but it also repeats the C1 scale already stated under the West Roof Cantilever claim. B is slightly vaguer ("structural member | dimension | 1/4\"") and attaches the questionable condition "detail 8" (a detail callout bubble) to the L3X3X1/4 angle. Neither captures the T.O. STEEL 11'-4", FIRST FLR 2'-4" or GRADE LEVEL 0" elevations shown on the page.
remarks: Both sets misread the two 1/4" slope (triangle) callouts in the A1 FLOOR OVERHANG DETAIL as thicknesses and as a slope of a generic "CANTILEVER DETAIL"; the correct reading is a 1/4" slope on the floor overhang, and the support plates are 11" wide x 3/8" thick per their own label. Both also duplicate the (2) 3/4" dia bolt fact under two names (angle connection / angle or connection fastener) and repeat the B-L1a-GF label as three separate trivial claims. Important facts both sets miss: T.O. STEEL elevation 11'-4", FIRST FLR 2'-4", GRADE LEVEL 0". The 1/4" value near the L4X4X5/16/W8X10 junction is not identified on the page as a weld size, so the "weld size" claims in both sets are unsupported.
